title: Causality Violation
description: Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

puzzle.goal: A signal is sent faster than light: it covers a distance Δx in time Δt. An observer moves at speed v along the same line. Write the time between emission and reception as that observer measures it, using the full transformation between the two frames with the time-dilation factor written out.
puzzle.name: Lorentz transformation of a time interval
puzzle.expr: ( v * Δx / c ^ 2 - Δt ) / sqrt ( 1 - v ^ 2 / c ^ 2 )
puzzle.ask: When vΔx/c² > Δt the result is negative: the moving observer sees the signal arrive before it was sent. Take c = 1, a signal at three times light speed (Δt = 1 s, Δx = 3 light-seconds) and v = 0.5; find by how much it arrives before it was sent.
puzzle.method: Mix time and space so that c²t² − x² is unchanged; the relative weight of x in the new time is v/c².
